subject: OCCURS clause
notes: kb/Work PB565 (2026-09-13). 'The TO and DEPENDING phrases shall either be both absent or both present' - ReportOccursOf compares oc.TO() against the DEPENDING dataReference and raises COBOL2021 when exactly one is written, before any repetition is bound. Format 3 is a COBOL-2002 introduction (construct report-occurs-2002; the COBOL-85 report group description entry has no OCCURS clause), so the rule's editions are 2002 onward. The positive golden writes the legal both-present shape (OCCURS 1 TO 4 TIMES DEPENDING ON WS-N STEP 4).
